summary: Reverified the reviewed card-height implementation (3c213639, unchanged src/ui/app.rs, src/ui/mapping.rs, and src/ui/timing.rs) for this execution: the mappings and timing cards still share one height in all four SOCD modes, with no source changes.

APP-CARDS-HEIGHT-MATCH.evidence: Re-executed on the unchanged implementation: the_two_settings_cards_match_height_in_every_mode asserts the two column rects share one height in all four modes (Immediate 514/514, PressDelay 489/489, RandomMix 489/489, ReleaseDelay 489/489, each equal to the taller card's natural frame), and the_card_row_re_measures_when_the_mode_changes asserts the row shrinks on a mode change and restores the first height on return. Both passed in this execution's egui-ui run (216 lib tests plus 6 semantic tests), as did the unowned tests/ui_semantic.rs flow against the same commit.

risks: The mapping card's leftover collects below its footer instead of pushing the footer to the card's bottom edge as the reference's justify-between does; the F06 acceptance fixes matching bottom edges only, and the leftover exists only in Immediate mode.

The row's shared target and the two natural heights travel through egui context memory under constant ids, because the card entry points must keep their signatures for the unowned tests/ui_semantic.rs; a second settings row on one page would share those keys.
The sizing pass uses request_discard, so a denied discard (max 2 passes) would show one stale frame, the same trade-off egui's Grid makes.

The assigned base commits carry the T2/T5/T6 integrations that this branch's copies of the three owned files predate; the changes are localized, but the integration merge still needs the Integrator's review of those files.
Native visual confirmation is outside this execution; the shared height is pinned by widget tests across the four modes only.
